GHSA-48p4-gj45-w9v6, GHSA-7qm8-hj35-269r, GHSA-2g6j-vhr6-6wrj: CPU exhaustion from derived images re-decoding a large image, repeated irot/imir/clap associations, and many coded pictures per decode. Shipped as one patch: the three share the security-limit code.
Upstream fix in libheif 1.23.7, tests/ hunks omitted.
